observed: Actual module and OCI containers run through owner CLI/API/SDK.
Held background work and the same lease survive host restart.
App environment and temporary filesystem data do not leak to the next slot assignment.
Idle slots stop through SIGTERM with Docker init and are reused with new credentials.
Old lease credentials and cross-app release source reads are rejected.
Virtual-host launch cookies gate frontend/backend access and hide server source.
limits: Linux Docker Engine acceptance, not macOS/Windows engine acceptance or browser cookie-policy proof.
